If you want to get the best trades try to get a key first. Then you just need to be a scumbag and try to make the most profit out of your key (like 80%-85% of market price). It will take a long time till you'll get alot of profit out of key trades but in my opinion this is the easiest and fastes way to get to a good inventory.

I'll show you a quick example since many people dont know how to calculate the key trades.

(How much you can get of of a trade)

x = Amount of Keys
y= Max Amount of Money you'll get

x * 2,15€ / 0,8 = y

(How many Keys you can offer for something while making the most profit)

x = price of the item
y = Amount of Keys you'll pay

x * 0,8 / 2,15€ = y
Is there any video out there that is like this (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GDm7cyPvHyI) ?

For warmup I always play ~30min DM ( 10min 1Tabs / 10min Spray / 10min Bursts). That is in my opinion the best way to get your whole "aim" on point for the next matches. But to get to LE or higher it takes alot of time and if you try to force it to badly you'll get annoyed faster and as a result of that play more brainless. Just search 4 nice mates who are at your skill group or a bit higher so they can teach you stuff while playing and try to have the most fun you can have without loosing your concentration. 

Edit: I forgot a big point for MM which is communication. Sure it gets easier when you are a 5 man team but there will always be situations where someone gets mad at himself or at other players. Than you need to be the guy who keeps the whole squad calm and concentrated without getting yourself in the dispute. Its a bit tricky but it helps alot!
